stem: Why does Marvin hope that his parents are listening to what the president is saying?

options.label: A
options.text: He wants his parents to support his goal to become president.

options.label: B
options.text: He wants his parents to realize that they should forgive him.

options.label: C
options.text: He believes that his parents might learn something about the president.

options.label: D
options.text: He thinks that the president might mention his parents on the news.
